title: Your First Tactic: The Fork
summary: Attack two enemy pieces at once and win material.

steps.text: A FORK is when one of your pieces attacks TWO enemy pieces at the same time! The enemy can only save one of them — so you win the other. Here, the White knight on d6 attacks both the king on e8 AND the queen on c8 at once!

steps.prompt: Find the knight move that attacks BOTH the king and the queen at once — that's a FORK!
steps.successText: Fork! Now Black can only save one piece — you'll win the queen!
steps.retryText: Look for a knight hop that hits both the king and the queen.

steps.text: After the fork, Black must move the king to escape check — but that means the queen gets left behind! Next turn, you capture her for free.

steps.prompt: Even a PAWN can fork! Push it forward to attack both the knight and the bishop at once.
steps.successText: Pawn fork! Black can't save both pieces.
steps.retryText: Push the pawn one square forward to attack both pieces diagonally.

steps.text: Forks are one of the best tricks in chess — always look for a square where your piece attacks two enemy pieces at once! Next: another sneaky tactic called the pin.
